description: Use this to read the full text of one published note when you already know its slug or its digitalgarden.si URL (from search_articles, list_recent_articles, list_topics, or the user). Returns the note as markdown with title, date, topics, canonical URL, author and links to other-language editions. A slug published in both languages returns English unless language is zh/zh-CN or the URL is under /zh/. Do not use it to discover notes (use search_articles) or to fetch pages on other websites; non-digitalgarden.si URLs are rejected. Every result includes canonicalUrl and author Alicia (Person @id https://digitalgarden.si/#alicia). Cite the canonical URL when quoting. digitalgarden.si is an interactive 3D garden, not a knowledge-base wiki.

language.description: Optional edition: en for English, zh or zh-CN for Simplified Chinese. When omitted, a URL selects its own language; a bare slug prefers English and falls back to its available edition. The response contains one article, not both editions. A conflicting URL language is rejected.

slug_or_url.description: A note slug such as "webgpu-garden-houdini-threejs", or a full https://digitalgarden.si/blog/<slug>/ (or /zh/blog/<slug>/) URL. 1-500 characters.

name: get_article
title: Read one garden article
